name: 吳和庭
objective: 本課程介紹通訊網路的各種架構及重要通信協定，內容包括：１.電腦網路概述與網路階層結構２.應用層架構及協定 ３.傳輸層架構及協定 ４.網路層架構及協定 ５.鏈路層及區域網路技術與應用６.無線及行動網路架構７.多媒體網路架構
課程進度(1-16週):
有關本課程教材、作業及相關公告事項，請隨時查詢本課程北科 i 學園 PLUS 的網頁。

Week 1: Introduction; Internet Architecture
Week 2: Protocol Layer and Their Service Models
Week 3: Data communication principles
Week 4;: Application Layer: Principles; Web and HTTP; E-mail System
Week 5;: Application Layer: DNS; P2P Application
Week 6: Transport Layer: Principles; Connectionless Transport; UDP protocol
Week 7: Transport Layer: Reliable Transport; TCP protocol; Congestion Control
Week 8: Midterm; The Network Layer-Data Plane: Data Forwarding Principles
Week 9:  The Network Layer-Data Plane: Router Architecture
Week 10: The Network Layer-Data Plane: IP Protocol
Week 11: The Network Layer-Control Plane: Routing Algorithms
Week 12: The Network Layer-Control Plane:SDN
Week 13: Data Link Layer: Principles
Week 14: Data Link Layer: Media Access Control Protocols
Week 15: Local Area Networks: Ethernet; Link-Layer Switching
Week 16: Final Exam.
Week 17: Flexible Learning: Wireless Links and Network; WiFi; Cellular Networks
Week 18: Flexible Learning: Wireless Network Related Homeworks and / or Report Submission
